name: zhanx-dentalcare
description: ZhanX DentalCare - Dental Clinic Management System

scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/desktop run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/desktop/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,vite,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.share: concurrently -k -n app,tunnel -c blue,yellow "npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run tunnel"
